description:
HUD Small Area Fair Market Rents for a 5-digit ZIP code (studio to 4 bedrooms, current and previous HUD
        fiscal year), with the 90-110% payment standard range and whether the metro is one of HUD's 65 designated Small
        Area FMR areas (where housing agencies must use the ZIP figures). Non-metropolitan ZIP codes have none: use
        fair_market_rent_by_county for those.
name: fair_market_rent_by_zip
